exposure: Duration of menstrual period (<15 days vs ≥15 days)
Success of vaginal repair (disappearance of CSD vs persistence of CSD)
cohort: Patients with CSD treated with vaginal repair between January 2014 and February 2016 at Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital
finding: A lower RMT/(RMT + D) ratio was associated with prolonged menstruation (≥15 days) and a higher likelihood of successful vaginal repair in women with CSD.
